metadata.description: Agent Skills suites: groups of skills that work together, one plugin per suite.

plugins.name: skill-suites-dr
plugins.description: Runs deep research with working memory on disk, either exploring a topic for leads or building a challenged, claim-checked report, then audits or refreshes past runs.

plugins.name: skill-suites-orch
plugins.description: Plans which of your installed skills to run for a problem, in what order and with what backups, then runs the plan with check-ins where you decide.
